newsitem.title: UK: Oasis fans get flowers after Liam cancels wedding.
newsitem.headline: Oasis fans get flowers after Liam cancels wedding.

text.p: A tiny group of Oasis fans who waited four hours in freezing rain to see Liam Gallagher wed actress Patsy Kensit were consoled with bouquets of white lilies on Monday after the marriage was unexpectedly called off.
Two 16-year-old girls from Belgium were less than impressed. "It's not as if he's even touched them," complained Klaartje De Vos from Antwerp.
Intense media speculation has surrounded the couple since they met last year at a time when Oasis was emerging as Britain's most popular band since the Beatles.

As photographers crammed into a tiny west London backstreet, outnumbering the half-dozen bedraggled fans, a surprise statement from Oasis's record company Creation said the wedding had been cancelled .
"Obsessive and intrusive media attention has removed any dignity from what was to be a private and special occasion," the statement said.
Delivery vans had been arriving since 6:00 am, bringing 25 crates of champagne, boxes of French wine, and white Casablanca' lilies worth 1,200 pounds ($2,000).
Police were called in and barriers erected around what was to have been the reception venue, tucked away behind Harrods department store.
Hours later, the same delivery vans returned to remove the flowers and crates of wine.
"I think the fans should get the flowers," said an employee of Lavender Flowers, which had prepared a minimalist bouquet' for Kensit with the exotic white lilies.
She handed the bouquets to the disppointed fans, who clutched cameras and autograph books.
Two guests showed up, only to be told, "It's off," by the doorman.
Earlier, Gallagher, the 24-year-old bad-boy' of British pop called the police to complain about press outside the couple's north London home.
Gallagher, who got engaged to Kensit last summer, told reporters through his intercom, "I'm not getting married today -- I'm in bed."
Kensit, 28, has been married twice before. Jim Kerr, singer of rock band Simple Minds, was her second husband.
